inlines.v: EX'QUISITELY, adverb Nicely; accurately; with great perfection; as a work exquisitely finished; exquisitely written. 1. With keen sensation or with nice perception. We feel pain more exquisitely when nothing diverts our attention from it. We see more exquisitely with one eye shut.
